content: Tsaurha Firis tur yi Melkidzedek

Melkidzedek kutǝr Salem ni, tǝ ƙǝm Firis yi Faara na manggǝn kalgha mbǝrha mu. Ƙǝmaghǝn tǝ Ibrahim a sayidɗi nǝn a wutta ɓa a kwasamadɗi hǝb nǝn yanda ǝnanǝn tǝ kutǝrya kal nǝn kanda mu, ƙǝma na nda hai, ɗǝfang parka nǝn in.
Tǝrgha Ibrahim fǝrang ǝnfǝra nǝn tal hu kum yi ǝngya wal nǝn ɓa hu yanda. Thlǝm Melkidzedek ndaarha ni, “Kutǝra yi nggayirha.” Tǝƙǝm, “Kutǝr Salem ni,” ndaarha ni, “Kutǝr tsawud ɗǝɗemnggirha.”
Mbǝ chireethla sǝ kyadgha chin Melkidzedek tǝ man nduwa turyighǝn wa. Mbǝ katǝra ɓenggǝn sǝ nduwa mii ngwala tsawudghǝn wa. Amma firis ni ndǝghǝn yi pakwanɗǝ, nǝghǝn ƙǝla Wan Faara.
Ƙǝlaman tur mamnggid niifɗiya. Ko Ibrahim riigha mii na chichid nǝm fǝrang ɗǝ tal hu kum ǝngya har nǝn ɓa ka yanda.
Nanǝnya ɗeleewar ngyakhrha Musa kyadɗǝ ndaarha turya Lawiya tsauka firis na nda thlǝ ǝnfǝra tal hu kum a haar nafiya Isǝreela ko nanǝn turya Ibrahim ni.
Amma Melkidzedek mbuwa tur Lawiya, thlǝɗǝ ǝnfǝra a haar Ibrahim, ɗǝfang parka nǝn Ibrahim teena ndǝghǝnggi ˈwagha thlǝ ɗǝfmi Faara.
Mbǝ ngaala sǝ wa yi na fǝr parka kalɗǝ yanɗi na a thlǝ parka mamnggirha.
A mbǝɗiya, firistaya na hu turya Lawiya nafiya ni mǝrgha, na nda thlǝ ǝnfǝra tal hu kum a haar fiya. Amma aten Melkidzedek, thlǝgha ǝnfǝra a haar Ibrahim thlǝk ndan tǝ ndaarha nǝghǝn tǝ yibrha fa.
Nanǝn kee, nǝm ndaarha Lawi tafadghǝn, tsauka turyighǝn ni na thlǝ ǝnfǝra, fǝrɗǝ yighǝn ǝnfǝra haaɗǝ a haar Ibrahim,
ƙǝsǝr a sayidɗi ƙǝmana Ibrahim hai tǝ Melkidzedek nggǝt wanda Lawi ˈwan wa, amma nǝghǝn hu turya chichidghǝn.
Na Yeeso ƙǝla Melkidzedek
Nanǝn kee, a ndam firistayirha yi Lawiya nǝghǝn mǝmǝl tǝ yi ɗeleewar ngyakhrha Musa fǝrang na nda Isǝreelaya, kama na firis nggǝr kyarha ɓa pak, na mǝmǝl tǝ tur yi Melkidzedek, mbǝ tur yi Haruna wa.
Ƙǝsǝr a nggǝrang nda kwaman firistayirha hai, tsauɗǝ tǝta ni a nggǝrang ngganda tsahad ngyakhrha hai ƙǝm.
Ƙǝsǝr firisɗi nǝm a thlǝk ǝnggini atenggǝn ya, nǝghǝn hu turya pak, mbǝ niifa sǝ ƙǝm ahur tur yini ˈwagha ǝna tar firis a mbǝd nji sataka wa.
Ƙǝsǝr nǝghǝn a pǝpal tǝ ndaarha Chinǝm ɓaghǝn ɓa ahu turya Yahuda, mbǝ ˈya sǝ ˈwana Musa thlǝkrha aten firistaya tǝ ndaarha na nda kyarha ɓa ahu turya Yahuda wa.
Laɓarɗi thlǝk nǝm ya tsauɗǝ ƙǝkafek, hǝrǝm nǝn naarha na firis sǝ na ƙǝla Melkidzedek kyagha ɓa.
Ndǝghǝnggi tsauka firis mbǝ ka ngyakhrha nduwa ǝntin thlufarha wa, amma nǝghǝn aten sǝsǝmnda yibrha mbuwana mii ngwaladghǝn sǝ.
Ƙǝsǝr pǝr ndan tǝ ndaarha, “Firis ni sa yi pakwanɗǝ, ƙǝla tur yi Melkidzedek.”
Malang nda tsahad kaar a man patu ɗǝ ƙǝsǝr ka yamid sǝsǝmndǝghǝn tǝ yamid thlarǝghǝn.
Ƙǝsǝr tsahad ɗeleewar Musa mbǝ tsawang ˈya lǝlǝgɗa wa. Amma nanǝnya na shiteena sǝ na ngga kaan ndusangga ƙǝm thlǝmad Faara ɓa.
Yanɗiya mbǝ kula tǝ aah thlǝm Faara wa. Fingya tsauka firisya, aah wa nda thlǝmnggǝn Faara wa.
Amma aahɗǝ thlǝm Faara kyanǝn hu tar firis hai ndangna Faara, “Chinǝm aah ɗǝ thlǝm Faara mbǝ tam hwasang ˈya ndanǝn wa, ‘Firis ni sa pakwanɗǝ.’”
Ƙǝsǝr ka aah Faarɗi ya, Yeeso ni katenggǝn na mbang tsawang nda ɗǝfmi ɗiya tsauka ngga tǝ Faara.
Firisya yi kaar na nda hangga, ƙǝsǝr mǝrra ndǝn ˈyaɗangga mana kanda fa a ɗǝnda mbeeɗǝ tǝ tar ndan.
Amma ƙǝsǝr na Yeeso tǝ yibrha fa pakwanɗǝ, Yighǝn firistayirha yi pakwanni ɗǝ.
Tsaunǝn kee, nǝn mbang hǝrghang nda nafiya ɓagha thlǝmad Faara ɓa tǝ man fadghǝn. Ƙǝsǝr nǝn naarha tsǝ laɓaara tǝ Faara a meyed ndan.
Tur mamnda firis ɗani ya na mid nǝm ƙǝsǝr nǝghǝn chahal, chahal kula ǝn ˈyaara fa, nǝghǝn inggun ma fa ɗimiya, tǝ mamnggirha a talakh talara.

Mbǝ ƙǝla fingya mamngya firistaya wa. Mbǝ midghǝnsǝ nagha a fǝr sataka ƙǝtsar wa. ˈWaghǝn fǝr sataka ka ɗimiyid aal fadghǝn, a nggǝrgha ǝnaarha ka ɗimiya fiya. Fǝrghǝn sataka katǝra tal ka ɗimiyid ndan a sayidɗi fǝr nǝn fadghǝn.
A hu ɗeleewar ngyakhrha Musa na nda wur mamnda firis hu ƙǝɗiirha nanǝnsǝ ahur fiya. Amma aah thlǝm Faara, ɓaghǝn ɓa a kwasamad ngyahadɗi, wurghǝn Wanɗi, tsauka chahal pakwanɗǝ.
